items.source: Note: Either MethodParameter or Field is available.

items.source: Exposed by UnsatisfiedDependencyException. Also available as an argument for factory methods, reacting to the requesting injection point for building a customized bean instance.
items.translation: 由UnsatisfiedDependencyException抛出。也可作为工厂方法的参数使用，针对请求的注入点响应以构建自定义 Bean 实例。

items.source: Note: In case of a method/constructor parameter, this exposes the annotations declared on the method or constructor itself (i.e. at the method/constructor level, not at the parameter level). Use getAnnotations() to obtain parameter-level annotations in such a scenario, transparently with corresponding field annotations.
items.translation: 注意：在方法/构造函数参数的情况下，这会暴露声明在该方法或构造函数本身上的注解（即在方法/构造函数级别，而非参数级别）。在此类场景中，请使用 getAnnotations() 来获取参数级别的注解，并透明地包含相应的字段注解。
